decision: Remain quarantined. Agent primary-source check only; not promoted to the runtime catalog. Promotion requires independent human scientific review, an owner-approved datasetVersion change and the per-record gate in data/migration/provenance-manifest.md.

source.method: Fresh download, SHA-256 matched; pdftotext -layout column offsets compared with header offsets; pages rendered at 110 dpi and visually inspected.

transcribedCells.observation: HCl 1.1 > 1.3; flame quenched after prolonged burn at 0.4 pot, one-sided flame; spread to top side and quenched immediately; did igniter wire affect top flame?

findings.finding: Legacy 16.5/16.4 come from the Initial/Final O2 columns, but the legacy note claims the calibrated column. Calibrated initial/final read 17.3/17.2.
findings.evidence: Header and value text offsets coincide (calibrated 587/616, uncalibrated 643/661) and the rendered yellow calibrated columns show 17.3/17.2.

findings.finding: 'Quenched as flow was reduced' is an authored interpretation. The row records quenching at a potentiometer setting (0.4 pot); the pot-to-velocity relationship is not established for this row.
findings.evidence: Observation column; footnote c defines pot as potentiometer.

findings.finding: The row records an anomaly question ('did igniter wire affect top flame?') and a one-sided flame; the legacy record has no quality flag.
Flow restrictor 2 is recorded but absent from the legacy record.

transcribedCells.observation: HCl 1.3 > 1.4; flame blew out at a pot of 6.0

findings.finding: Legacy 16.4/16.3 come from the Initial/Final O2 columns, but the legacy note claims the calibrated column. Calibrated initial/final read 17.3/17.2.
findings.evidence: Header and value text offsets coincide (calibrated 579/608, uncalibrated 635/653) and the rendered yellow calibrated columns show 17.3/17.2.

findings.finding: B19 used flow restrictor 0, whereas B16 and B20 used 2. The report states restrictors change the maximum duct flow (~55 cm/s with none, ~35 cm/s with two). Legacy omits this setup difference.
findings.evidence: Flow restrictor column; PDF page 12 / printed 4, section 1.2 hardware description.

findings.finding: 'Blew off at high flow' is an authored interpretation. The row records blow-out at a pot of 6.0; the air velocity at blow-out is not recorded in the row.

crossRecordFindings: B20 (as-run 50), B16 (51) and B19 (52) ran on the same day with nominally the same PMMA film specification, but differ in calibrated initial oxygen (17.4 vs 17.3 vol%), flow sequence, sample number and, for B19, flow restrictor. They are not a controlled single-variable airflow series.
Do not apply a universal 16.x → 17.x offset: the calibrated-minus-uncalibrated difference is 0.8 (B16 initial), 0.9 (B19 initial, B20 initial) and varies by row.
